## Decision

We decided to implement the new architecture using a modular approach.
Each component is independently deployable and testable. The main
benefits include better separation of concerns and easier testing.

## Implementation

The implementation follows the standard pattern established in our
codebase. Components communicate through well-defined interfaces.

### Phase 1

First phase focuses on the core infrastructure.

### Phase 2

Second phase adds the user-facing features.

## Consequences

This decision means we need to update the deployment pipeline.
The team will need training on the new module system.
